name: navigation-shell
implemented: Added a responsive AppShell with desktop top navigation, mobile bottom navigation, login/profile action area, and page anchor links.
Added customer/worker mode and light/dark theme controls as client components.
Reworked the MVP home page into real dashboard sections under the shared shell.
Added navigation shell tests, Testing Library setup, and foundation data coverage for both full and short labels.
Added explicit responsive CSS guards so desktop navigation is hidden on mobile and mobile navigation is hidden on desktop.
mistakes_recorded: Avoid running Next.js type generation and build/typecheck concurrently because .next/types can race.
After responsive navigation changes, verify computed mobile display values instead of relying only on unit tests.
